comment: Display-only city barrier palettes (sRGB), shared by barrier_detail_meshes.gd (shader slots) and mapkit-package barrier_design.rs (variant choice, distant colours). Fence families: steel bar, welded mesh, chain-link, wooden, pipe rail; wall families: brick, painted block, precast, stone; hedge leaf tones. bay_m is the post or pier lattice (real metres; wall patterns repeat whole per bay). far_opacity (per fence family; board_far_opacity for wooden boards) is the share a fence keeps once its infill is unresolved (near far meshes and the distant prism colour).
